assumptions: ASM-MEDIATION-UNIVERSE is the declared U and is undischarged.
attrs.evidence: None. The ARCHITECTURAL half of GPT-5.6's law, and it cannot be enforced from inside the system it describes. GPT-5.6's operational form ends `any unmediated external observation ⇒ τ is inadmissible`; that clause presupposes the system can DETECT an unmediated observation, and if it could detect it the observation would be mediated. So it is not a runtime rule. It is the statement of the property, discharged by an argument about the execution environment or not at all — which is what SRC-ANDERSON-1972-REFMON already concedes by listing EVALUABLE beside non-bypassable. SRC-BATES-2015-LPM is the demonstration of the only route that has actually worked: do not argue the universe is closed, REDUCE it to a lower monitor whose mediation over a typed object set was independently verified, and inherit. There is a decidable shadow, weaker than the property and stronger than nothing: enumerate every exported path that performs the effect and refuse any that is not the mediator. scripts/check-mutation-surface.mjs has been doing exactly that for Ledger `bal` writes since R5.1, and its own first run flagged a comment, which is the honest summary of what a surface scan resolves.
attrs.gap: No runtime, no mediator, no universe discharge. The tree can state the law and can state what would discharge it; it can do neither.
attrs.prior_art: GPT-5.6, on ROUND7_2_MOSAIC_BRIEF.md §8.1. SRC-ANDERSON-1972-REFMON, SRC-SALTZER-1975-MEDIATION, SRC-BATES-2015-LPM.

readjudicated.method: question_survives — an OPEN claim asserts nothing that could transfer; the question is re-posed against the target tree
readjudicated.note: The source-lane status is recorded in imported_from.source_status as provenance. This field records that the TARGET lane re-established it; the two are separate facts and the gate reads this one.

attrs.review_focus: The interesting question is no longer whether the channel list is long enough. It is whether there is a lower monitor to reduce to. LPM had LSM; this architecture would need the inference call to be the only exported path to an external effect, which makes the universe the runtime export surface rather than a list someone wrote.
attrs.statement: Over the declared universe U, there exists no path by which an operation obtains an effect-relevant input outside a mediator.
